info.title: Deposit Desk
info.description: Refundable holds for agents renting real-world things. The agent holds $1.00 USDC with x402 upto on Solana, the desk checks whether the need is already handled, then keeps the hold as the rental or returns it.
info.x-guidance: Read GET /v1/terms first (free). Then call POST /v1/rent/charger or POST /v1/rent/hotspot through a payment-aware client. The first response is a 402 x402 upto offer for a hold of up to $1.00; the client pays and retries, and the desk settles $1.00 when the rental is kept or $0.01 when the need is already handled. One call is one hold, so do not repeat a call that returned 200.

get.summary: Read desk terms, refund rules and device public key
get.description: Free, no payment. Returns the rules the desk applies when it settles a hold and the devicePublicKey that verifies signed readings.

items.description: Per item hold_usd, check_fee_usd, check question and settlement rules.

post.summary: Start a charger rental with a refundable $1 hold
post.description: Holds up to $1.00, then checks whether the device is already drawing AC power. Already on power: $0.01 check fee, $0.99 returned. On battery and power arrives within wait_seconds: $1.00 kept. Power never arrives: $0.01, $0.99 returned.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for power to arrive when the device starts on battery. Keep it well under the 300 second payment timeout.

200.description: Hold settled: kept as the rental or refunded, with a signed device reading.

decision.description: kept when the rental is delivered, refunded otherwise.

charged_usd.description: USD settled to the desk, 1.00 or 0.01.

returned_usd.description: USD returned to the payer, 0.00 or 0.99.

reason.description: The refund rule that applied, in plain English.

signed_reading.description: Device reading signed with the desk device ed25519 key. A failed check returns an unsigned reading with outcome check_failed.

detail.description: Short machine reason, for example device_on_AC or charging_verified.

raw.description: The raw device observation the decision was based on.

signature.description: Hex ed25519 signature over the reading fields.

devicePublicKey.description: Hex ed25519 public key, same value as GET /v1/terms devicePublicKey.

settlement_tx.description: Solana settlement transaction signature, present when available.

network.description: Network the hold settled on: localnet in the Pay.sh sandbox, mainnet when live.

402.description: Payment Required. x402 upto offer for a hold of up to 1 USDC (1000000 base units).

post.summary: Start a hotspot rental with a refundable $1 hold
post.description: Holds up to $1.00, then checks whether the device is already on the venue network. Already on it: $0.01 check fee, $0.99 returned. Off the venue network: hotspot rental kept, $1.00 charged.
